title: Sector average volume
statementMd:
Average daily volume per sector (rounded to the nearest whole number).

Expected columns: `sector`, `avg_volume`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT t.sector, ROUND(AVG(p.volume)) AS avg_volume FROM prices p JOIN tickers t ON t.symbol = p.symbol GROUP BY t.sector;
```
